[Haulien] The GT4000 is $103.07 after using the AUCD13 coupon, and I think is worth the extra cost for the 100w charging, especially if you intend on using it as a powerbank.

[LowRange] As someone who has both i agree, would rather spend the bit extra and get the GT400.
[deadpoet] Agreed that the GT4000 is the better choice. If I'm understanding the specs correctly, the 15W or 10W charging output of the GP4000 Pro limits its overall usefulness, which is a shame as it otherwise looks pretty decent.
[kbw] These things are seriously impressive, I've given one as a gift to a farmer family member and it's lasted years jumping everything from small stationary engines up to trucks and tractors. They actually went out and got two more so each ute has one living in it 24/7.
[Averell] Is this suitable for occasional use (like once every 1-2 years)?
Thanks
[Sfh1975] Yes, keep it 80% charged with occasional topups, away from sunlight, such as deep in the boot or dash.
